notes.title: JOLLY'S PARK - UPDATE 1.0.1 PART 1
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys! In part 1 of 1.0.1 we fixed the main glitches and improved optimization, also we changed some meshes![/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the ventilation glitch, where you could uncrouch and fly away by the map.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Changed the final Wally chase model.
[/list]

[b]Improved optimization, removing some post processing effects:[/b]

[list]
[*] Global Illumination
[*] Temperature Color
[*] Motion Blur
[*] Depth of Field
[/list]

[b]WHAT IS COMING ON PART 2?[/b]

[list]
[*] Localization (Portuguese, Spanish, German, etc..)
[*] Cutscenes (Chases, fights.)
[*] Improved animations (Removing generic animations.)
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed the ventilation glitch, where you could uncrouch and fly away by the map.

tags.feature: Changed the final Wally chase model.
